fiber-optics/multi-core.title: Multi-Core Fiber Crosstalk
fiber-optics/multi-core.description: Simplified coupled-mode estimate of inter-core coupling, crosstalk and packing density in a homogeneous multi-core fiber versus core pitch and length.

free-space-comms/acquisition-tracking.title: FSO Acquisition and Tracking

free-space-comms/adaptive-optics-gain.title: Adaptive Optics Strehl Gain
free-space-comms/adaptive-optics-gain.description: Fitting and Greenwood temporal error, corrected Strehl ratio, AO gain, and the actuators and bandwidth needed for a target Strehl in turbulence.

free-space-comms/adaptive-optics.title: Adaptive Optics for FSO

free-space-comms/quantum-key-distributio.title: QKD Secure Key Rate
